sources.title: Sentiment analysis prebuilt AI model - AI Builder | Microsoft Learn
sources.snippet: The sentiment analysis prebuilt model detects positive or negative sentiment in text data. You can use it to analyze social media, customer reviews, or any text data you're interested in. Sentiment analysis evaluates text input, and gives scores and labels at a sentence and document level.

sources.title: sentiment.ai - GitHub Pages
sources.snippet: Overview sentiment.ai turns text into sentiment scores using a sentence-embedding model plus a small, bundled scoring head. The default backend is the on-device multilingual model multilingual-e5-base (no TensorFlow, no API key, no data leaving your machine).
